page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan is not the case; one page of text in two columns of running text, with a narrow column of marginal notes at the left and a table of legions set in the middle of the page. Left margin: the marginal word "Legiones" and "Cohortes urbana / Auxiliares" and "Pofferorum erratum" and "Pacis artes" in small type beside the text. Right margin: a column of numerals beside the legion table. Running head at top; page number at top right. Below the table, the main text continues in full width.

main_text.p: tæ, fed valido cum remige. Hæc Italiæ à fubito extétˆs norum incurfu, (nam cætera Alpes claudebant) hæc à piratarum infolentia cuftodia. Sed præcipuum ro-Legiones burimperii in terreftri militia, & legionum aptapet provincias connexione, collocabatur. Quarum fituit & numerum ob oculos, quafi in brevitabella, pone- thus.
main_text.head: Legiones
main_text.p: Urbem verò tres urbanæ, novem prætoriæ cohortes, infidebant. Auxiliares cohortes, & focias provin- ciarum triremes, numero comprehendere, fupervaˆ cuum autori vifum. Unde colligitur, ingentes in ar- mâ expenfas Remp. Romanam, pacifico licet gen- tium feculo, toleraviffe. Quas cum concidere By- zantini imperatores, militemque & ætma undique dimittere, in animum induxerunt, non fumptu im- perium Romanum, fed fecuritate pacis levaverunt; Barbaris enim in pacatas, armis nudatas, longo otio florentes, regionesalle&is, virtute veterum parta uno momento everterunt. Alendæ igitur in pace copiæ militum, repentinum fubitæ formidini auxilium, & fpei barbaræ invasionis impedimentum.
main_text.head: VI.
Urbana negotia militaribus, præstan- tia aut curæ necessitate, non cedunt.
main_text.p: Minus enim est hostem armis repellere, quàm ci- vem in officio continere. Illud fortunæ fæpè est aut alicujus animorum impetus, hoc confidenti animi folertiæ.

page.notes: The scan is of low quality; the marginal numerals and the left-margin catchwords are approximate. Several words in the table and the notes are doubtful and were not marked with [?] individually. Printed text in the left margin ("Cohortes urbanæ", "Auxiliares", "Pofferorum errata", "Pacis artes") is partly illegible and is only approximated. Long s and printed ligatures in the scan were normalised to plain s. The final word "folertiæ" appears as a catchword and is shown in the catchword element; it may not be exact.
